title: UEFA CEDB/AB - 22.04.2026
text:
CONTROL, ETHICS AND DISCIPLINARY BODY 
APPEALS BODY 

Decisions of 22 April 2026 

 
 
 
 
 CEDB & AB Meeting – 22 April 2026 

Dear Sir or Madam, 

Please see below the main elements of the decisions taken by the UEFA Control, Ethics and Disciplinary Body (CEDB) 
and UEFA Appeals Body on 22 April 2026.  

If,  following  a  request  by  the  party  concerned,  a  decision  with  grounds  is  issued,  that  full  decision  will  be  made 
available in the case law section of this website after it becomes final and binding. 

To navigate this document, you can click on the name of a case in the contents to jump to that particular sanction 
and click on the header at the top of any page to return to the contents.  

We trust this document will be of interest.  

Yours faithfully, 

UEFA 

Angelo Rigopoulos  
Executive Director of Integrity & Regulatory  

William McAuliffe 
Head of Disciplinary

Raków Częstochowa vs. ACF Fiorentina (1:2); 19 March 2026 

Raków Częstochowa 
Incidents and sanction: 

• 

Lighting of fireworks, Art. 16(2)(c) DR 

  Fine: €25,000 
  Partial stadium closure for the next one (1) UEFA club competition match it plays as host club. Said

  Suspension: one (1) UEFA club competition match
